note: The balcony and indoor plants, from the inventory spreadsheet. A plant is matched to a species only where the sheet's own botanical name matches one outright; those inherit the watering, feeding, pruning and repotting schedule from data/species.json. The rest keep the name the sheet gave them and fall back to the generic seven-day watering reminder, with no feeding, pruning or repotting dates — a guessed species would produce a confident schedule for the wrong plant. Nothing was invented: pot type, growing medium, condition and identification confidence are kept in the notes, where the record has no field for them.
